## Background: Synchrony estimates using Sncf{ncf}

#### How it works:

Sncf computes the nonparametric spatial (auto/cross-)correlation
function for multivariate time series data observed across spatial
locations.

1.  Takes time series data z from n locations (one row per location, one
    column per time step).

2.  Calculates the pairwise correlations between time series at each
    location pair.

3.  Bins those correlations based on distance between sites (using
    latitude and longitude if latlon = TRUE).

4.  Fits a smoothing spline to estimate the average correlation as a
    function of distance
    
It can handle missing data, where:
na.rm = TRUE: Missing values are allowed; only overlapping time steps are used in correlations.


#### Metrics to consider:

-   '\real$predicted\$y[1]' = Synchrony at (almost) zero distance –
    often max synchrony.
      
      - This is the first predicted value from the fitted nonparametric spline of the spatial correlation function
      
      - Estimated synchrony at the smallest distance bin


-   '\$y.intercept' = Extrapolated synchrony at exactly zero distance 
      
      - The theoretical synchrony among perfectly co-located sites

-   '\$cbar' = Regional mean synchrony across all distances

-   '\$x.intercept'	= Distance at which synchrony drops to 0

-   '\$e.intercept' = Distance where synchrony drops to 1/e of max (decay scale)





## Part 1: Synchrony in metabolism at differnt timescales

Compare synchrony for GPP and ER from 56 different sites in Marzolf
dataset at different timescales:

-   Daily

-   Weekly (mean)

-   Monthly (mean)

-   Quarterly (3 month mean)

-   Yearly (mean)

### A. GPP synchrony at differnt timescales:

#### GPP- Daily synchrony

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=T, include=T, cache=TRUE}

#### Daily synchrony

river_metab_dat<-as.data.frame(river_metab_dat)

GPP_long <- river_metab_dat %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, date, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(GPP_filled = mean(GPP_filled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

GPP_wide_day <- GPP_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = date,
    values_from = GPP_filled)

# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
RR_df.corr_day <- Sncf(x=GPP_wide_day$Lon,
                   y=GPP_wide_day$Lat,
                   z=GPP_wide_day[,4:ncol(GPP_wide_day)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm = T) # allows for NA given each stream has 280 days per year

plot(RR_df.corr_day)

GPP_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(RR_df.corr_day)
Regional.synch <- GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch


# Plot using ggplot for export
# create a dataframe of the predicted values
GPP.corr.pred.df.day <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_day$real$predicted$x)),
                                             y = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_day$real$predicted$y)),
                               time_scale = "daily",
                               parameter = "GPP")

## Sample average line
GPP.corr.pred.df.day$mean_synch <- round(Regional.synch,2)
Regional.synch_x <-  round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0)
GPP.corr.pred.df.day$cbar <- Regional.synch_x

# ...and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction
GPP.corr.bootValues.df <- as.data.frame(t(RR_df.corr_day$boot$boot.summary$predicted$y))

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
GPP.corr.boot.df.day <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_day$boot$boot.summary$predicted$x)),
                                             yminGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.df$`0.025`,
                                             ymaxGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.df$`0.975`,
                               time_scale = "daily",
                                  parameter = "GPP")

```

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T, cache=TRUE}

cat(paste0(
  "$y.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "y"], 2), "\n",
  "$Regional.synch: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch[1], 2), "\n",  
  "$cbar: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0), " km\n",
  "$x.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$quantiles["0.5", "x"], 0), " km\n"
))

```

#### GPP- Weekly synchrony

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=F, cache=TRUE}
#### Weekly synchrony

GPP_week <-  river_metab_dat %>%
  mutate(week=week(date))%>%
  group_by(Site_ID, week, year, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(GPP_filled = mean(GPP_filled, na.rm=T))

GPP_wide_week <- GPP_week %>%
  dplyr::select(Site_ID, Lon, Lat, week, year, GPP_filled) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(year, week), values_from = GPP_filled) %>%
  # Reorder columns: keep Site_ID, Lon, Lat first, then order year_week columns
  {
    static_cols <- c("Site_ID", "Lon", "Lat")
    dynamic_cols <- setdiff(names(.), static_cols)
    
    # Extract year and week and sort
    sorted_dynamic_cols <- dynamic_cols[order(
      as.integer(sub("^(\\d+)_\\d+$", "\\1", dynamic_cols)),   # year part
      as.integer(sub("^\\d+_(\\d+)$", "\\1", dynamic_cols))    # week part
    )]
    
    dplyr::select(., all_of(static_cols), all_of(sorted_dynamic_cols))
  }

GPP_wide_week_1 <-na.omit(GPP_wide_week)

# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
RR_df.corr_wk <- Sncf(x=GPP_wide_week$Lon,
                   y=GPP_wide_week$Lat,
                   z=GPP_wide_week[,4:ncol(GPP_wide_week)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm=T)


plot(RR_df.corr_wk)


GPP_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(RR_df.corr_wk)

# Plot using ggplot for export

                                     time_scale = "weekly",
                                     parameter = "GPP")

GPP.corr.pred.df.wk$cbar <- Regional.synch_x


# ...and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
```

###### Calculate the percent difference in synchrony between time scales from daily

```{r, echo=F, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

# Spread the data so each time_scale becomes a column
pred_wide <- pred_df_all %>%
  dplyr::select(x, y, time_scale) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time_scale, values_from = y)

# Calculate percent differences from daily for each other time scale
# Formula: ((other - daily) / daily) * 100
pred_diff <- pred_wide %>%
  mutate(
    weekly_diff = (abs(weekly - daily) / daily) * 100,
    monthly_diff = (abs(monthly - daily) / daily) * 100,
    quarterly_diff = (abs(quarterly - daily) / daily) * 100,
    yearly_diff = (abs(yearly - daily) / daily) * 100
  )

pred_diff
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=F, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
# Set a color-blind friendly palette
scale_colors <- c(
  "daily" = "#E69F00",     
  "quarterly" = "#56B4E9",    
  "monthly" = "#009E73",   
  "weekly" = "#F0E442", 
  "yearly" = "#0072B2"    
)
```

###### Precent difference in GPP snych signal from daily 

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=F, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
# Pivot longer
pred_long_diff <- pred_diff %>%
  dplyr::select(x, ends_with("_diff")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_diff"),
    names_to = "time_scale",
    values_to = "percent_diff"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_scale = gsub("_diff", "", time_scale)
  )

# Plot histogram
ggplot(pred_long_diff, aes(x = percent_diff, fill = time_scale)) +
  geom_density(position = "identity", alpha = 0.6, bins = 30) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Percent Difference from Daily by Time Scale",
    x = "Percent Difference from Daily (%)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Time Scale"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

### Figure 2 (a): Spline Correlogram of GPP at different timescales

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
library(grid)

library(patchwork)

### add point for mean GPP to plot 
library(geosphere)
# Get site centroids
site_coords <- GPP_long %>%
  group_by(Site_ID) %>%
  summarise(Lat = mean(Lat), Lon = mean(Lon), .groups = "drop")

# Choose a reference site (the first one in the dataset)
ref_site <- site_coords[1, ]

# Compute distance in km from reference site
site_coords <- site_coords %>%
  mutate(distance_km = distHaversine(matrix(c(Lon, Lat), ncol = 2),
                                     matrix(c(ref_site$Lon, ref_site$Lat), ncol = 2)) / 1000)

GPP_long_dist <- GPP_long %>%
  left_join(site_coords %>% dplyr::select(Site_ID, distance_km), by = "Site_ID")


GPP_long_dist_plt <- GPP_long_dist %>%
  mutate(GPP_P = ifelse(!is.na(GPP_filled), -0.2, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, distance_km, GPP_P) %>%
  summarise(
    GPP_mean = median(GPP_filled, na.rm = TRUE), 
    GPP_low = quantile(GPP_filled, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
    GPP_up = quantile(GPP_filled, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

###
GPP_synch_spline <- ggplot() +
  # Ribbon for CI
  geom_ribbon(data = ci_df_all%>%dplyr::filter(x<3150),
              aes(x = x, ymin = yminGPP, ymax = ymaxGPP, fill = time_scale),
              alpha = 0.1) +
  # Main spline lines
  geom_line(data = pred_df_all%>%dplyr::filter(x<3150),
            aes(x = x, y = y, color = time_scale),
            size = 1) +
  geom_segment(data = intersection_df,
               aes(x = 0, xend = x, 
                   y = y, yend = y,
                   color = time_scale),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  # Draw vertical segments from bottom to y_intersect
  geom_segment(data = intersection_df,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, 
                   y = -0.2, yend = y,
                   color = time_scale),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  # Add GPP points (mean)
  geom_point(data = GPP_long_dist_plt,
             aes(x = distance_km, y = GPP_P),
             shape = 4, size = 2,
             alpha=0.5) +
    ylim(-0.2, 0.75) +
  # Labels and theme
  labs(title = "Synchrony in GPP across different time scales",
       y = "Correlation",
       x = "Distance (km)",
       fill = "Time Scale",
       color = "Time Scale") +
  scale_color_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Rotated density plot (marginal plot for y-axis)
density_plot_y <- ggplot(pred_long_diff%>%dplyr::filter(x<3150), aes(x = percent_diff, fill = time_scale)) +
  geom_density(position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +  # Rotate 90 degrees
  scale_fill_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent difference from daily synchrony",
    y = "Density") +
  theme_classic() +
theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
  plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5, 5, 5, 5, unit = "pt"),
legend.position = "none"
)


# Combine using patchwork (put rotated density plot on the right)
combined_plot <- GPP_synch_spline + density_plot_y +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(3, 1))
combined_plot
```

###### Rate of GPP synchrony decay with distance:

Where b parameter represents the decay rate: higher b = faster loss of
synchrony with distance.

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T}

fit_models <- pred_df_all %>%
  group_by(time_scale) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(model = map(data, ~ nls(y ~ a * exp(-b * x), data = ., start = list(a = 1, b = 0.001))),
         params = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(params) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value), ~ round(.x, 5), .names = "rounded_{.col}"))

fit_models_tab <- as.data.frame(fit_models)%>%
  dplyr::select(time_scale, term,rounded_estimate: rounded_p.value)

fit_models_tab


```

### B. ER synchrony at differnt timescales:

#### ER - Daily synchrony:

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=F, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, cache=TRUE}
ER_long <- river_metab_dat %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, date, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(ER_filled = mean(ER_filled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ER_wide_day <- ER_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = date,
    values_from = ER_filled)

# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
ER_df.corr_day <- Sncf(x=ER_wide_day$Lon,
                   y=ER_wide_day$Lat,
                   z=ER_wide_day[,4:ncol(ER_wide_day)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm = T)


plot(ER_df.corr_day)


ER_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(ER_df.corr_day)

# Plot using ggplot for export
# create a dataframe of the predicted values
ER.corr.pred.df.day <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(ER_df.corr_day$real$predicted$x)),
                                             y = matrix(unlist(ER_df.corr_day$real$predicted$y)),
                               time_scale = "daily",
                                  parameter = "ER")


## Sample average line
Regional.synch <- ER_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch
ER.corr.pred.df.day$mean_synch <- round(Regional.synch,2)

Regional.synch_x <-  round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0)
ER.corr.pred.df.day$cbar <- Regional.synch_x

# ...and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction
ER.corr.bootValues.df <- as.data.frame(t(ER_df.corr_day$boot$boot.summary$predicted$y))

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
ER.corr.boot.df.day <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(ER_df.corr_day$boot$boot.summary$predicted$x)),
                                             yminER = ER.corr.bootValues.df$`0.025`,
                                             ymaxER = ER.corr.bootValues.df$`0.975`,
                               time_scale = "daily",     
                               parameter = "ER")


```


```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T, cache=TRUE}

cat(paste0(
  "$y.intercept: ", round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "y"], 2), "\n",
  "$Regional.synch: ", round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch[1], 2), "\n",  
  "$cbar: ", round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0), " km\n",
  "$x.intercept: ", round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$quantiles["0.5", "x"], 0), " km\n"
))

```

#### ER - Weekly synchrony

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=F, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, cache=TRUE}
ER_week <-  river_metab_dat %>%
  mutate(week=week(date))%>%
  group_by(Site_ID, week, year, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(ER_filled = mean(ER_filled, na.rm=T))

ER_wide_week <- ER_week %>%
  dplyr::select(Site_ID,Lon, Lat, week, year, ER_filled) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(year, week), values_from = ER_filled)

river_metab_dat<- as.data.frame(river_metab_dat)

ER_wide_week <- ER_week %>%
 # dplyr::filter(year>2011) %>%
 dplyr::select(Site_ID, Lon, Lat, week, year, ER_filled) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(year, week), values_from = ER_filled) %>%
  # Reorder columns: keep Site_ID, Lon, Lat first, then order year_week columns
  {
    static_cols <- c("Site_ID", "Lon", "Lat")
    dynamic_cols <- setdiff(names(.), static_cols)
    
    # Extract year and week and sort
    sorted_dynamic_cols <- dynamic_cols[order(
      as.integer(sub("^(\\d+)_\\d+$", "\\1", dynamic_cols)),   # year part
      as.integer(sub("^\\d+_(\\d+)$", "\\1", dynamic_cols))    # week part
    )]
    
    dplyr::select(., all_of(static_cols), all_of(sorted_dynamic_cols))
  }


# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
RR_df.corr_wk <- Sncf(x=ER_wide_week$Lon,
                   y=ER_wide_week$Lat,
                   z=ER_wide_week[,4:ncol(ER_wide_week)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm=T)


plot(RR_df.corr_wk)


ER_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(RR_df.corr_wk)
# Plot using ggplot for export
# create a dataframe of the predicted values

                                             y = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_wk$real$predicted$y)),
                                     time_scale = "weekly",     
                                 parameter = "ER")
## Sample average line

ER.corr.pred.df.wk$mean_synch <- round(Regional.synch,2)

Regional.synch_x <-  round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0)
ER.corr.pred.df.wk$cbar <- Regional.synch_x

# ...and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction
ER.corr.bootValues.df <- as.data.frame(t(RR_df.corr_wk$boot$boot.summary$predicted$y))

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
ER.corr.boot.df.wk <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_wk$boot$boot.summary$predicted$x)),
                                             yminER = ER.corr.bootValues.df$`0.025`,
                                             ymaxER = ER.corr.bootValues.df$`0.975`,

                                     parameter = "ER")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=F, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}


# Spread the data so each time_scale becomes a column
pred_wide_ER <- pred_df_all_ER %>%
  dplyr::select(x,y,time_scale)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time_scale, values_from = y)

# Calculate percent differences from daily for each other time scale
# Formula: ((other - daily) / daily) * 100
pred_diff_ER <- pred_wide_ER %>%
  mutate(
    weekly_diff = (abs(weekly - daily) / daily) * 100,
    monthly_diff = (abs(monthly - daily) / daily) * 100,
    quarterly_diff = (abs(quarterly - daily) / daily) * 100,
    yearly_diff = (abs(yearly - daily) / daily) * 100
  )



# Pivot longer
pred_long_diff_ER <- pred_diff_ER %>%
 dplyr:: select(x, ends_with("_diff")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_diff"),
    names_to = "time_scale",
    values_to = "percent_diff"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_scale = gsub("_diff", "", time_scale)
  )


# Plot histogram
ggplot(pred_long_diff_ER, aes(x = percent_diff, fill = time_scale)) +
  geom_density(position = "identity", alpha = 0.6, bins = 30) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Percent Difference from Daily by Time Scale",
    x = "Percent Difference from Daily (%)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Time Scale"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

### Figure 2 (b): Spline Correlogram of ER at different timescales

Points represent site with metabolism estimates


```{r, echo=FALSE, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

library(broom)
### add point for mean ER to plot 
library(geosphere)

site_coords <- ER_long %>%
  group_by(Site_ID) %>%
  summarise(Lat = mean(Lat), Lon = mean(Lon), .groups = "drop")

# Choose a reference site (e.g., the upstream-most one)
ref_site <- site_coords[1, ]

# Compute distance in km from reference site
site_coords <- site_coords %>%
  mutate(distance_km = distHaversine(matrix(c(Lon, Lat), ncol = 2),
                                     matrix(c(ref_site$Lon, ref_site$Lat), ncol = 2)) / 1000)

ER_long_dist <- ER_long %>%
  left_join(site_coords %>% dplyr::select(Site_ID, distance_km), by = "Site_ID")




ER_long_dist_plt <- ER_long_dist %>%
  mutate(ER_P = ifelse(!is.na(ER_filled), -0.2, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, distance_km, ER_P) %>%
  summarise(
    ER_mean = median(ER_filled, na.rm = TRUE), 
    ER_low = quantile(ER_filled, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
    ER_up = quantile(ER_filled, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


###
ER_synch_spline <- ggplot() +
  # Ribbon for CI
  geom_ribbon(data = ci_df_all_ER%>%dplyr::filter(x<3150),
              aes(x = x, ymin = yminER, ymax = ymaxER, fill = time_scale),
              alpha = 0.1) +
  # Main spline lines
  geom_line(data = pred_df_all_ER%>%dplyr::filter(x<3150),
            aes(x = x, y = y, color = time_scale),
            size = 1) +
   geom_segment(data = intersection_df,
               aes(x = 0, xend = x, 
                   y = y, yend = y,
                   color = time_scale),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  # Draw vertical segments from bottom to y_intersect
  geom_segment(data = intersection_df,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, 
                   y = -0.2, yend = y,
                   color = time_scale),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  # Add ER points (mean)
  geom_point(data = ER_long_dist_plt,
             aes(x = distance_km, y = ER_P),
             shape = 4, size = 2,
             alpha=0.5) +
  # Labels and theme
  labs(title = "Synchrony in ER across different time scales",
       y = "Correlation",
       x = "Distance (km)",
       fill = "Time Scale",
       color = "Time Scale") +
  scale_color_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Rotated density plot (marginal plot for y-axis)
density_plot_y <- ggplot(pred_long_diff_ER%>%dplyr::filter(x<3150), aes(x = percent_diff, fill = time_scale)) +
  geom_density(position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +  # Rotate 90 degrees
  scale_fill_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent difference from daily synchrony",
    y = "Density") +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5, 5, 5, 5, unit = "pt"),,
        legend.position="none")

# Combine using patchwork (put rotated density plot on the right)
combined_plot <- ER_synch_spline + density_plot_y +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(3, 1))
combined_plot
```

#### LAI Daily synch (filled)

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=F, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}

str(LAI_dat)

stream_LAI_dat <- LAI_dat %>%
  left_join(river_metab_dat, by = c("Site_ID", "date"))

### 

LAI_long <- stream_LAI_dat %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, date, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(Lai = mean(Lai, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


LAI_filled_coords <- LAI_long %>%
  group_by(Site_ID) %>%
  fill(Lat, Lon, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()


LAI_filled_coords1 <- LAI_filled_coords %>%
  group_by(Site_ID) %>%
  fill(Lai, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()

LAI_wide_day <- LAI_filled_coords1 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = date,
    values_from = Lai)

LAI_wide_day<- na.omit(LAI_wide_day)

# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
LAI_df.corr_day <- Sncf(x=LAI_wide_day$Lon,
                   y=LAI_wide_day$Lat,
                   z=LAI_wide_day[,4:ncol(LAI_wide_day)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm = T)


plot(LAI_df.corr_day)


LAI_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(LAI_df.corr_day)

# Plot using ggplot for export
# create a dataframe of the predicted values
LAI.corr.pred.df.day <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(LAI_df.corr_day$real$predicted$x)),
                                             y = matrix(unlist(LAI_df.corr_day$real$predicted$y)),
                               time_scale = "daily",
                               parameter="LAI")

## Sample average line
Regional.synch <- LAI_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch
LAI.corr.pred.df.day$mean_synch <- round(Regional.synch,2)

Regional.synch_x <-  round(LAI_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0)
LAI.corr.pred.df.day$cbar <- Regional.synch_x


# ...and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction
LAI.corr.bootValues.df <- as.data.frame(t(LAI_df.corr_day$boot$boot.summary$predicted$y))

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
LAI.corr.boot.df.day <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(LAI_df.corr_day$boot$boot.summary$predicted$x)),
                                             yminLAI = LAI.corr.bootValues.df$`0.025`,
                                             ymaxLAI = LAI.corr.bootValues.df$`0.975`,
                               time_scale = "daily",
                                parameter="LAI")

```

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T, cache=TRUE}

  "$y.intercept: ", round(LAI_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "y"], 2), "\n",
  "$Regional.synch: ", round(LAI_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch[1], 2), "\n",  
  "$cbar: ", round(LAI_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0), " km\n",
  "$x.intercept: ", round(LAI_corrgram_summary.table$quantiles["0.5", "x"], 0), " km\n"
))
```

###### Quantify synchrony decay with distance:

Where b parameter represents the decay rate: higher b = faster loss of
synchrony with distance.

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(broom)

fit_models <- pred_df%>%dplyr::filter(x<2500) %>% # adjust to x at sample dist 
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(model = map(data, ~ nls(y ~ a * exp(-b * x), data = ., start = list(a = 1, b = 0.001))),
         params = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(params)

fit_models

```

| Variable | a (initial synch) | b (decay rate) | Interpretation |
|-----------|----------:|----------:|-----------------------------------------|
| **Q (Flow)** | 0.6937 | 0.00223 | Starts moderately synchronized, but decays rapidly over space. |
| **GPP** | 0.2597 | 0.000037 | Low synchrony, and it barely decays — very stable across space, suggesting local factors |
| **Water Temp** | 0.9361 | 0.0000285 | High synchrony, — very stable across space |
| **PPT (Precip)** | 0.9009 | 0.00277 | High synchrony, but decays quickly — similar to flow. Tight confidence intervals. |
| **Air Temp** | 0.9853 | 0.000103 | The most synchronous slowly decaying — regional coherence in air temp. Tight confidence intervals |
| **LAI** | 0.6879 | 0.000153 | Moderate synchrony and mild decay — stable across space, suggesting local factors |


###### Main take-aways from Fig 3

A. Looks like GPP has the lowest synchrony, showing it is the most
influenced by localized differences.

B. GPP becomes asynchronous at much smaller distances (797 km shorter
\~64% than LAI), and at faster rates (64% delta b: 0.0004).

#####  Random forest to get at what should describe National Land Cover Database

```{r, size='large', echo=T, include=T, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
library(randomForest)

# Prepare data for RF
rf_LC_data <- river_metab_dat1[, c("Developed_OpenSpace_pct", "Developed_LowIntensity_pct",
                       "Developed_MedIntensity_pct", "Developed_HiIntensity_pct",
                       "Barren_Land_pct", "Forest_Deciduous_pct",
                       "Water_Open_pct", "Ice_Snow_Perennial_pct",
                       "Shrub_Scrub_pct", "Grass_landHerbaceous_pct",
                       "Forest_Evergreen_pct", "Forest_mixed_pct",
                       "Grass_PastureHay_pct", "Cultivated_Crops_pct",
                       "Wetlands_Woody_pct","Wetlands_EmergentHerb_pct",
                       "road_Rural_den", "road_private_den", "road_Total_den")]


rf_LC_input <- data.frame(GPP_synch = river_metab_dat1$GPP_filled, rf_LC_data)
rf_LC_input_clean <- na.omit(rf_LC_input)

# Now run the model
rf_LC_model <- randomForest(GPP_synch ~ ., data = rf_LC_input_clean,
                         importance = TRUE, ntree = 200)

# Plot importance
varImpPlot(rf_LC_model)

# Get importance metrics from your existing model
importance_vals <- randomForest::importance(rf_LC_model, type = 1)  # type = 1 for %IncMSE
importance_df <- data.frame(variable = rownames(importance_vals),
                            IncMSE = importance_vals[, 1])

# Sort by importance and keep top 10
top_vars_LC <- importance_df %>%
  arrange(desc(IncMSE)) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  pull(variable)

top_vars_LC

```

###### A. How much variance in GPP is explained by landscape?

*Land cover (LC) PCA:* Represents gradient from developed to
natural/forested areas

-   PC1: Higher more forested, less developed, lower more developed,
    less natural land

-   PC2: Higher more shrub/evergreen forest, lower more open grass land
    or agricultural

###### Daily synchrony in GPP based PC of land cover Q1

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=F}
GPP_long_q1 <- land_cover_q1 %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, date, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(GPP_filled = mean(GPP_filled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

GPP_wide_day_q1 <- GPP_long_q1 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = date,
    values_from = GPP_filled)

# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
RR_df.corr_LC_q1 <- Sncf(x=GPP_wide_day_q1$Lon,
                   y=GPP_wide_day_q1$Lat,
                   z=GPP_wide_day_q1[,4:ncol(GPP_wide_day_q1)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm = T) # allows for NA given each stream has 280 days per year


plot(RR_df.corr_LC_q1)


GPP_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(RR_df.corr_LC_q1)

# Plot using ggplot for export
# create a dataframe of the predicted values
GPP.corr.pred.LC.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_LC_q1$real$predicted$x)),
                                             y = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_LC_q1$real$predicted$y)),
                               time_scale = "daily",
                               parameter = "GPP",
                               strat = "Developed")

## Sample average line
Regional.synch <- GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch
GPP.corr.pred.LC.Q1$mean_synch <- round(Regional.synch,2)

Regional.synch_x <-  round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0)
GPP.corr.pred.LC.Q1$cbar <- Regional.synch_x




# ...and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction
GPP.corr.bootValues.LC.Q1 <- as.data.frame(t(RR_df.corr_LC_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$y))

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
GPP.corr.boot.LC.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_LC_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$x)),
                                             yminGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.LC.Q1$`0.025`,
                                             ymaxGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.LC.Q1$`0.975`,
                               time_scale = "daily",
                                  parameter = "GPP",
                               strat = "Developed")

```



```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T, cache=TRUE}
cat(paste0(
  "$y.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "y"], 2), "\n",
  "$Regional.synch: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch[1], 2), "\n",  
  "$cbar: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0), " km\n",
  "$x.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$quantiles["0.5", "x"], 0), " km\n"
))
```

###### Calculate the percent difference between different land cover types

```{r, echo=F, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

# Spread the data so each LC Q becomes a column
pred_wide <- pred_df_all %>%
  dplyr::select(x_rounded_5, y, strat) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = strat, values_from = y)

# Calculate percent differences from daily for each other time scale
# Formula: ((other - daily) / daily) * 100
pred_diff <- pred_wide %>%
  mutate(
    LQ1_diff = (abs(Developed - Developed) / Developed) * 100,
    LQ2_diff = (abs(Developed - Moderate) / Developed) * 100,
    LQ3_diff = (abs(Developed - Natural) / Developed) * 100)

pred_diff
```

###### Quantify synchrony decay with distance:

Where b parameter represents the decay rate: higher b = faster loss of
synchrony with distance.

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T}

fit_models <- pred_df_all %>% dplyr::filter(x < 860) %>%
  group_by(strat) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(model = map(data, ~ nls(y ~ a * exp(-b * x), data = ., start = list(a = 1, b = 0.001))),
         params = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(params) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value), ~ round(.x, 4), .names = "rounded_{.col}"))

fit_models_tab <- as.data.frame(fit_models)%>%
  dplyr::select(strat, term,rounded_estimate: rounded_p.value)

fit_models_tab
```

### B. Sediment/ geologic land cover

```{r, size='large', echo=F, include=T, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
library(randomForest)

# Prepare data for RF
rf_geol_data <- river_metab_dat1[, c("geol_gneiss", "geol_granitic",
                       "geol_ultramafic", "geol_quarternary",
                       "geol_sedimentary", "geol_volcanic",
                       "geol_ultramafic", "geol_anorthositic",
                       "geol_intermediate_pultonic")]


rf_geol_input <- data.frame(GPP_synch = river_metab_dat1$GPP_filled, rf_geol_data)
rf_geol_input_clean <- na.omit(rf_geol_input)

# Now run the model
rf_geol_model <- randomForest(GPP_synch ~ ., data = rf_geol_input_clean,
                         importance = TRUE, ntree = 200)

# Plot importance
varImpPlot(rf_geol_model)

# Get importance metrics from your existing model
importance_vals <- randomForest ::importance(rf_geol_model, type = 1)  # type = 1 for %IncMSE
importance_df <- data.frame(variable = rownames(importance_vals),
                            IncMSE = importance_vals[, 1])

# Sort by importance and keep top 10
top_vars_geol <- importance_df %>%
  arrange(desc(IncMSE)) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  pull(variable)

```

```{r, size='large', echo=FALSE, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
### start the PCA
```

###### Daily synchrony Geology Q1

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=F}
GPP_long_q1 <- geol_q1 %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, date, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(GPP_filled = mean(GPP_filled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

GPP_wide_day_q1 <- GPP_long_q1 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = date,
    values_from = GPP_filled)

# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
RR_df.corr_GL_q1 <- Sncf(x=GPP_wide_day_q1$Lon,
                   y=GPP_wide_day_q1$Lat,
                   z=GPP_wide_day_q1[,4:ncol(GPP_wide_day_q1)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm = T) # allows for NA given each stream has 280 days per year


plot(RR_df.corr_GL_q1)


GPP_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(RR_df.corr_GL_q1)

# Plot using ggplot for export
# create a dataframe of the predicted values
GPP.corr.pred.GL.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_GL_q1$real$predicted$x)),
                                             y = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_GL_q1$real$predicted$y)),
                               time_scale = "daily",
                               parameter = "GPP",
                               strat = "Metamorphic_Ingeous")

## Sample average line
Regional.synch <- GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch
GPP.corr.pred.GL.Q1$mean_synch <- round(Regional.synch,2)

Regional.synch_x <-  round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0)
GPP.corr.pred.GL.Q1$cbar <- Regional.synch_x


# ...and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction
GPP.corr.bootValues.GL.Q1 <- as.data.frame(t(RR_df.corr_GL_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$y))

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
GPP.corr.boot.GL.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_GL_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$x)),
                                             yminGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.GL.Q1$`0.025`,
                                             ymaxGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.GL.Q1$`0.975`,
                               time_scale = "daily",
                                  parameter = "GPP",
                               strat = "Metamorphic_Ingeous")

```


```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T, cache=TRUE}
cat(paste0(
  "$y.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "y"], 2), "\n",
  "$Regional.synch: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch[1], 2), "\n",  
  "$cbar: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0), " km\n",
  "$x.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$quantiles["0.5", "x"], 0), " km\n"
))
```

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T}

  nest() %>%
  mutate(model = map(data, ~ nls(y ~ a * exp(-b * x), data = ., start = list(a = 1, b = 0.001))),
         params = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(params) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value), ~ round(.x, 5), .names = "rounded_{.col}"))

fit_models_tab <- as.data.frame(fit_models)%>%
  dplyr::select(strat, term,rounded_estimate: rounded_p.value)

fit_models_tab
```

### C. Basin characteristics

```{r, size='large', echo=T, include=T, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

# Prepare data for RF
rf_basin_data <- river_metab_dat1[,c("lengthkm", "shape_length", "streamleve", 
                                     "streamorde", "streamcalc", "totdasqkm", "slope",
                                     "pathlength")]


rf_basin_input <- data.frame(GPP_synch = river_metab_dat1$GPP_filled, rf_basin_data)
rf_basin_input_clean <- na.omit(rf_basin_input)

# Now run the model
rf_basin_model <- randomForest(GPP_synch ~ ., data = rf_basin_input_clean,
                         importance = TRUE, ntree = 200)

# Plot importance
varImpPlot(rf_basin_model)

# Get importance metrics from your existing model
importance_vals <- randomForest ::importance(rf_basin_model, type = 1)  # type = 1 for %IncMSE
importance_df <- data.frame(variable = rownames(importance_vals),
                            IncMSE = importance_vals[, 1])

# Sort by importance and keep top 10
top_vars_basin <- importance_df %>%
  arrange(desc(IncMSE)) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  pull(variable)
```

###### Create the composite variable for basin characteristics

```{r, size='large', echo=FALSE, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
### start the PCA 
pca_basin_dat <- river_metab_dat1 %>%
  dplyr::select(Site_ID,  all_of(top_vars_basin))

pca_basin_data1 <- pca_basin_dat %>%
  group_by(Site_ID) %>%
      summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Prepare data for PCA by removing non-numeric and non-relevant columns
pca_basin_data <- pca_basin_data1 %>% 
  dplyr::select(-Site_ID) %>% 
  dplyr::select(where(~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE) != 0)) %>%  # Drop columns with no variance
  as.matrix()

pca_basin_input_clean <- na.omit(pca_basin_data)

domains <- dat_NHDinfo$state

# Apply the categorization to column names
smry_categories <- factor(sapply(colnames(pca_basin_data), function(col) {
  col_patterns[col]
}))


pca_basin <- prcomp(pca_basin_input_clean, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Visualize PCA eigenvalues
scree_plt_basin <- fviz_eig(pca_basin)
scree_plt_basin

# ggsave(plot = scree_plt_basin, filename = paste("/Users/kellyloria/Documents/River_Recovery_Dynamics_Analysis/figures/Watershed_attributes_screeplt_basin_25.png",sep=""),width=4,height=3.5,dpi=300)


biplot(prcomp(pca_basin_input_clean, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE))


# Visualize PCA biplot with variable categories
watershed_loadplot_basin<- fviz_pca_biplot(pca_basin, geom.var = 'arrow', geom.ind = 'point', title = '',
                col.var = smry_categories)

watershed_loadplot_basin

# ggsave(plot = watershed_loadplot_basin, filename = paste("/Users/kellyloria/Documents/River_Recovery_Dynamics_Analysis/figures/Watershed_attributes_load_basin_25.png",sep=""),width=5,height=3.5,dpi=300)

```

*PC1:*

-   Higher values represent larger, higher order, more dendritic streams
    while lower values represent steeper, smaller, lower-order streams

*PC2:*

-   High PC2 shorter streams with more branching (higher
    streamcalc/streamorde) while lower represents longer more linear
    streams

```{r, size='large', echo=FALSE, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
# Get the scores (principal component axes)

basin_pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_basin$x)

basin_pca_input_clean_sites <- na.omit(pca_basin_data1)

# Add sites
basin_pca_with_site <- cbind(Site_ID=basin_pca_input_clean_sites$Site_ID, basin_pca_scores)

# Add GPP_synch back in (at the annual scale)

  left_join(basin_pca_with_site, by=c("Site_ID"))
```

#### Daily synchrony basin Q1

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=F}
GPP_long_q1 <- basin_q1 %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, date, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(GPP_filled = mean(GPP_filled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

GPP_wide_day_q1 <- GPP_long_q1 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = date,
    values_from = GPP_filled)

# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
RR_df.corr_BC_q1 <- Sncf(x=GPP_wide_day_q1$Lon,
                   y=GPP_wide_day_q1$Lat,
                   z=GPP_wide_day_q1[,4:ncol(GPP_wide_day_q1)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm = T) # allows for NA given each stream has 280 days per year


plot(RR_df.corr_BC_q1)


GPP_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(RR_df.corr_BC_q1)

# Plot using ggplot for export
# create a dataframe of the predicted values
GPP.corr.pred.BC.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_BC_q1$real$predicted$x)),
                                             y = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_BC_q1$real$predicted$y)),
                               time_scale = "daily",
                               parameter = "GPP",
                               strat = "Steep_small")

## Sample average line
Regional.synch <- GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch
GPP.corr.pred.BC.Q1$mean_synch <- round(Regional.synch,2)

Regional.synch_x <-  round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0)
GPP.corr.pred.BC.Q1$cbar <- Regional.synch_x


# ...and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction
GPP.corr.bootValues.BC.Q1 <- as.data.frame(t(RR_df.corr_BC_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$y))

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
GPP.corr.boot.BC.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_BC_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$x)),
                                             yminGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.BC.Q1$`0.025`,
                                             ymaxGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.BC.Q1$`0.975`,
                               time_scale = "daily",
                                  parameter = "GPP",
                               strat = "Steep_small")

```



```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=T, include=T, cache=TRUE}
cat(paste0(
  "$y.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "y"], 2), "\n",
  "$Regional.synch: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch[1], 2), "\n",  
  "$cbar: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0), " km\n",
  "$x.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$quantiles["0.5", "x"], 0), " km\n"
))
```

##### Calculate the percent difference between different basin character types

```{r, echo=F, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

  dplyr::select(x_rounded_5, y, strat) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = strat, values_from = y)

# Calculate percent differences from daily for each other time scale
# Formula: ((other - daily) / daily) * 100
pred_diff_basin <- pred_wide_basin %>%
  mutate(
    Steep_small_diff = (abs(Steep_small - Steep_small) / Steep_small) * 100,
    Moderate_diff = (abs(Steep_small - Moderate) / Steep_small) * 100,
    Large_branched_diff = (abs(Steep_small - Large_branched) / Steep_small) * 100)
```

## Part 4: How much variance in GPP/ER is explained by temperature, flow, and streamlight

#### A. Water temp.

```{r, size='large', echo=FALSE, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}

df_wtemp <- river_metab_dat1 %>%
  mutate(temp_quantile = ntile(temp.water, 3)) %>%
  mutate(temp_category = case_when(
    temp_quantile == 1 ~ "Q1",
    temp_quantile == 2 ~ "Q2",
    temp_quantile == 3 ~ "Q3"
  ))

```

```{r, size='large', echo=F, include=T, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
ggplot(df_wtemp, aes(x = temp.water, fill = factor(temp_category))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(

    name = "temp category",

  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Water temp. values by quantile",
       x = "Water temp.",
       y = "Count")
```

GLM:

```{r, size='large', echo=FALSE, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(MuMIn)

lm_model_temp <- lmer(log(GPP_filled) ~ temp.water + (1|temp_category), data = df_wtemp)
summary(lm_model_temp)
hist(residuals(lm_model_temp))
r.squaredGLMM(lm_model_temp)

lm_model_tempn <- lm(log(GPP_filled) ~ temp.water, data = df_wtemp)
summary(lm_model_tempn)
hist(residuals(lm_model_tempn))
```

#### Daily synchrony GPP and Water temp Q1

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=F}
GPP_long_q1 <- df_wtemp %>%
  dplyr::filter(temp_category=="Q1") %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, date, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(GPP_filled = mean(GPP_filled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

GPP_wide_day_q1 <- GPP_long_q1 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = date,
    values_from = GPP_filled)

# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
RR_df.corr_temp_q1 <- Sncf(x=GPP_wide_day_q1$Lon,
                   y=GPP_wide_day_q1$Lat,
                   z=GPP_wide_day_q1[,4:ncol(GPP_wide_day_q1)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm = T) # allows for NA given each stream has 280 days per year


plot(RR_df.corr_temp_q1)


GPP_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(RR_df.corr_temp_q1)

# Plot using ggplot for export
# create a dataframe of the predicted values
GPP.corr.pred.temp.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_temp_q1$real$predicted$x)),
                                             y = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_temp_q1$real$predicted$y)),
                               time_scale = "daily",
                               parameter = "GPP",
                               strat = "temp_Q1")

## Sample average line
Regional.synch <- GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch
GPP.corr.pred.temp.Q1$mean_synch <- round(Regional.synch,2)

Regional.synch_x <-  round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0)
GPP.corr.pred.temp.Q1$cbar <- Regional.synch_x

# ...and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction
GPP.corr.bootValues.temp.Q1 <- as.data.frame(t(RR_df.corr_temp_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$y))

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
GPP.corr.boot.temp.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_temp_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$x)),
                                             yminGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.temp.Q1$`0.025`,
                                             ymaxGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.temp.Q1$`0.975`,
                               time_scale = "daily",
                                  parameter = "GPP",
                               strat = "temp_Q1")

```


```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=T, include=T, cache=TRUE}
cat(paste0(
  "$y.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "y"], 2), "\n",
  "$Regional.synch: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch[1], 2), "\n",  
  "$cbar: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0), " km\n",
  "$x.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$quantiles["0.5", "x"], 0), " km\n"
))
```

##### Calculate the percent difference between different flow quantiles

```{r, echo=F, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

# Spread the data so each LC Q becomes a column
pred_wide_temp <- pred_df_all_temp %>%
  dplyr::select(x_rounded_5, y, strat) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = strat, values_from = y)

# Calculate percent differences from daily for each other time scale
# Formula: ((other - daily) / daily) * 100
pred_diff_temp <- pred_wide_temp %>%
  mutate(
    temp_Q1_diff = (abs(temp_Q1 - temp_Q1) / temp_Q1) * 100,
    temp_Q2_diff = (abs(temp_Q1 - temp_Q2) / temp_Q1) * 100,
    temp_Q3_diff = (abs(temp_Q1 - temp_Q3) / temp_Q1) * 100)

pred_diff_temp
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=F, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=F, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

###
GPP_synch_spline_temp <- ggplot() +
  # Ribbon for CI
  geom_ribbon(data = ci_df_all_temp,
              aes(x = x, ymin = yminGPP, ymax = ymaxGPP, fill = strat),
              alpha = 0.1) +
  # Main spline lines
  geom_line(data = pred_df_all_temp,
            aes(x = x, y = y, color = strat),
            size = 1) +
  labs(title = "GPP synchrony across water temperature quantiles",
              y = "Correlation",
       x = "Distance (km)",
       fill = "Quantiles",
       color = "Quantiles") +
  scale_color_manual(values = strat_colors,
                         labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = strat_colors,     
                    labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3")) +
   geom_segment(data = intersection_df,
               aes(x = 0, xend = x, 
                   y = y, yend = y,
                   color = strat),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  # Draw vertical segments from bottom to y_intersect
  geom_segment(data = intersection_df,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, 
                   y = -0.2, yend = y,
                   color = strat),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic() +   ylim(-0.2, 0.75) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

GPP_synch_spline_temp

```


Catchments with underlying metamorphic rock are more similar than
igneous or sedimentary

### Quantify synchrony decay with distance:

Where b parameter represents the decay rate: higher b = faster loss of
synchrony with distance.

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T}

fit_models <- pred_df_all_temp %>% dplyr::filter(x<580)%>%
  group_by(strat) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(model = map(data, ~ nls(y ~ a * exp(-b * x), data = ., start = list(a = 1, b = 0.001))),
         params = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(params) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value), ~ round(.x, 5), .names = "rounded_{.col}"))

fit_models_tab <- as.data.frame(fit_models)%>%
  dplyr::select(strat, term,rounded_estimate: rounded_p.value)

fit_models_tab
```

### Quantify synchrony decay with distance:

Where b parameter represents the decay rate: higher b = faster loss of
synchrony with distance.

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T}

fit_models <- pred_df_all_temp %>%
  group_by(strat) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(model = map(data, ~ nls(y ~ a * exp(-b * x), data = ., start = list(a = 1, b = 0.001))),
         params = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(params) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value), ~ round(.x, 5), .names = "rounded_{.col}"))

fit_models_tab <- as.data.frame(fit_models)%>%
  dplyr::select(strat, term,rounded_estimate: rounded_p.value)

fit_models_tab
```

#### Daily synchrony GPP and flow Q1

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=F}
GPP_long_q1 <- df_flow %>%
  dplyr::filter(flow_category=="Q1") %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, date, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(GPP_filled = mean(GPP_filled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

GPP_wide_day_q1 <- GPP_long_q1 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = date,
    values_from = GPP_filled)

# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
RR_df.corr_flow_q1 <- Sncf(x=GPP_wide_day_q1$Lon,
                   y=GPP_wide_day_q1$Lat,
                   z=GPP_wide_day_q1[,4:ncol(GPP_wide_day_q1)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm = T) # allows for NA given each stream has 280 days per year


plot(RR_df.corr_flow_q1)


GPP_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(RR_df.corr_flow_q1)

# Plot using ggplot for export
# create a dataframe of the predicted values
GPP.corr.pred.flow.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_flow_q1$real$predicted$x)),
                                             y = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_flow_q1$real$predicted$y)),
                               time_scale = "daily",
                               parameter = "GPP",
                               strat = "flow_Q1")

## Sample average line
Regional.synch <- GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch
GPP.corr.pred.flow.Q1$mean_synch <- round(Regional.synch,2)

Regional.synch_x <-  round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0)
GPP.corr.pred.flow.Q1$cbar <- Regional.synch_x


# ...and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction
GPP.corr.bootValues.flow.Q1 <- as.data.frame(t(RR_df.corr_flow_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$y))

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
GPP.corr.boot.flow.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_flow_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$x)),
                                             yminGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.flow.Q1$`0.025`,
                                             ymaxGPP = GPP.corr.bootValues.flow.Q1$`0.975`,
                               time_scale = "daily",
                                  parameter = "GPP",
                               strat = "flow_Q1")

```


```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T, cache=TRUE}
cat(paste0(
  "$y.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "y"], 2), "\n",
  "$Regional.synch: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch[1], 2), "\n",  
  "$cbar: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0), " km\n",
  "$x.intercept: ", round(GPP_corrgram_summary.table$quantiles["0.5", "x"], 0), " km\n"
))
```

##### Calculate the percent difference between different flow quantiles

```{r, echo=F, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

# Spread the data so each LC Q becomes a column

  dplyr::select(x_rounded_5, y, strat) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = strat, values_from = y)

# Calculate percent differences from daily for each other time scale
# Formula: ((other - daily) / daily) * 100
pred_diff_flow <- pred_wide_flow %>%
  mutate(
    flow_Q1_diff = (abs(flow_Q1 - flow_Q1) / flow_Q1) * 100,
    flow_Q2_diff = (abs(flow_Q1 - flow_Q2) / flow_Q1) * 100,
```

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=T, include=T}

intersection_df <- pred_df_all_flow %>%
  group_by(strat) %>%
  summarise(
    y= mean(mean_synch),
    x = mean(cbar))

intersection_df
```


```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=T, include=T}

ER_synch_spline_flow <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = ci_df_all_flow,
              aes(x = x, ymin = yminER, ymax = ymaxER, fill = strat),
              alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df_all_flow,
            aes(x = x, y = y, color = strat),
            size = 1) +
  # Draw horizontal segments from start to x_intersect
  geom_segment(data = intersection_df,
               aes(x = 0, xend = x, 
                   y = y, yend = y,
                   color = strat),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  # Draw vertical segments from bottom to y_intersect
  geom_segment(data = intersection_df,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, 
                   y = -0.2, yend = y,
                   color = strat),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "ER synchrony across flow quantiles",
       y = "Correlation",
       x = "Distance (km)",
       fill = "Quantiles",
       color = "Quantiles") +
  scale_color_manual(values = strat_colors,
                         labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = strat_colors,     
                    labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3")) +
  theme_classic() +  ylim(-0.2, 0.75) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


```



### Quantify synchrony decay with distance:

Where b parameter represents the decay rate: higher b = faster loss of
synchrony with distance.

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T}

fit_models <- pred_df_all_flow %>% dplyr::filter(x<805) %>%
  group_by(strat) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(model = map(data, ~ nls(y ~ a * exp(-b * x), data = ., start = list(a = 1, b = 0.001))),
         params = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(params) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value), ~ round(.x, 5), .names = "rounded_{.col}"))

fit_models_tab <- as.data.frame(fit_models)%>%
  dplyr::select(strat, term,rounded_estimate: rounded_p.value)

fit_models_tab
```

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=F}
    names_from = date,
    values_from = ER_filled)

# Now, calculate spatial Synchrony in the time series using the Sncf() function
RR_df.corr_light_q1 <- Sncf(x=ER_wide_day_q1$Lon,
                   y=ER_wide_day_q1$Lat,
                   z=ER_wide_day_q1[,4:ncol(ER_wide_day_q1)],
                   resamp = 1000, 
                   latlon = T,
                   na.rm = T) # allows for NA given each stream has 280 days per year


plot(RR_df.corr_light_q1)


ER_corrgram_summary.table <- summary(RR_df.corr_light_q1)

# Plot using ggplot for export
# create a dataframe of the predicted values
ER.corr.pred.light.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_light_q1$real$predicted$x)),
                                             y = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_light_q1$real$predicted$y)),
                               time_scale = "daily",
                               parameter = "ER",
                               strat = "light_Q1")

## Sample average line
Regional.synch <- ER_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch
ER.corr.pred.light.Q1$mean_synch <- round(Regional.synch,2)

Regional.synch_x <-  round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0)
ER.corr.pred.light.Q1$cbar <- Regional.synch_x


# ..and a dataframe of the y values for the bootstrap prediction
ER.corr.bootValues.light.Q1 <- as.data.frame(t(RR_df.corr_light_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$y))

# merge x and y values (min and max) for the bootstrap confidence intervals into a dataframe
ER.corr.boot.light.Q1 <- data.frame(x = matrix(unlist(RR_df.corr_light_q1$boot$boot.summary$predicted$x)),
                                             yminER = ER.corr.bootValues.light.Q1$`0.025`,
                                             ymaxER = ER.corr.bootValues.light.Q1$`0.975`,
                               time_scale = "daily",
                                  parameter = "ER",
                               strat = "light_Q1")

```


```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T, cache=TRUE}
cat(paste0(
  "$y.intercept: ", round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "y"], 2), "\n",
  "$Regional.synch: ", round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$Regional.synch[1], 2), "\n",  
  "$cbar: ", round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$estimates["intercepts", "cbar"], 0), " km\n",
  "$x.intercept: ", round(ER_corrgram_summary.table$quantiles["0.5", "x"], 0), " km\n"
))
```

##### Calculate the percent difference between different light quantiles


```{r, echo=F, include=T, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

# Spread the data so each LC Q becomes a column
pred_wide_light <- pred_df_all_light %>%
  dplyr::select(x_rounded_5, y, strat) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = strat, values_from = y)

# Calculate percent differences from daily for each other time scale
# Formula: ((other - daily) / daily) * 100
pred_diff_light <- pred_wide_light %>%
  mutate(
    light_Q1_diff = (abs(light_Q1 - light_Q1) / light_Q1) * 100,
    light_Q2_diff = (abs(light_Q1 - light_Q2) / light_Q1) * 100,
    light_Q3_diff = (abs(light_Q1 - light_Q3) / light_Q1) * 100)

pred_diff_light
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=F, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
)
```

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=T, include=T}
  group_by(strat) %>%
  summarise(
    y= mean(mean_synch),
    x = mean(cbar))

intersection_df
```

### Figure 4c (?): Spline Correlogram of GPP at different light characteristics

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=T, include=T}

ER_synch_spline_light <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = ci_df_all_light,
              aes(x = x, ymin = yminER, ymax = ymaxER, fill = strat),
              alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df_all_light,
            aes(x = x, y = y, color = strat),
            size = 1) +
  # Draw horizontal segments from start to x_intersect
  geom_segment(data = intersection_df,
               aes(x = 0, xend = x, 
                   y = y, yend = y,
                   color = strat),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  # Draw vertical segments from bottom to y_intersect
  geom_segment(data = intersection_df,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, 
                   y = -0.2, yend = y,
                   color = strat),
               linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "ER synchrony across light quantiles",
       y = "Correlation",
       x = "Distance (km)",
       fill = "Quantiles",
       color = "Quantiles") +
  scale_color_manual(values = strat_colors,
                         labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = strat_colors,     
                    labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3")) +
  theme_classic() +  ylim(-0.2, 0.75) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


```


### Quantify synchrony decay with distance:

Where b parameter represents the decay rate: higher b = faster loss of
synchrony with distance.

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, include=T}

fit_models <- pred_df_all_light %>%
  group_by(strat) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(model = map(data, ~ nls(y ~ a * exp(-b * x), data = ., start = list(a = 1, b = 0.001))),
         params = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(params) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value), ~ round(.x, 5), .names = "rounded_{.col}"))

fit_models_tab <- as.data.frame(fit_models)%>%
  dplyr::select(strat, term,rounded_estimate: rounded_p.value)

fit_models_tab
```
